refreshNotes: First customer-delivery model year. Bespoke build-to-order ultra-luxury sedan, deliveries began June 2025. Base price ~$340,000 before bespoke options. 111-kWh battery, 655 hp / 646 lb-ft dual-motor AWD, 303-mile EPA range, 3.7 second 0-60. 55-inch dash-spanning display, 38-speaker AKG audio, electrochromic glass roof. Sources: [Wikipedia Celestiq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cadillac_Celestiq), [KBB Celestiq](https://www.kbb.com/cadillac/celestiq/).
